action: I mark a safe route with the wayfinder chalk.

plan.title: The Dusk Atlas
plan.premise: A mountain archive redraws its maps at dusk and traps an expedition beyond a moving ridge.
plan.objective: Recover the atlas page and guide the expedition home before dusk.
plan.opening: At dusk, every map changes at once; a fresh trail appears behind the archive.

locations.name: Mountain Archive
locations.description: A stone archive with moving ink on its walls.

locations.name: Wind Courtyard
locations.description: A roofless court filled with torn map fragments.

locations.name: Sealed Vault
locations.description: A cold vault holding the atlas page and gear.

characters.name: Sela Venn
characters.description: A stubborn archivist with ink-stained gloves.
characters.motivation: Bring her students home from the ridge.

items.name: Wayfinder Chalk
items.description: Chalk that marks paths the mountain cannot move.

items.name: Smoked Lens
items.description: A lens that reveals hidden ink.

secrets: The ridge moves when someone lies.

add_facts: The chalk reveals a route the ridge cannot move.
The shifting ink points toward the sealed vault.
